Write a Python function to compute the derivative of the ReLU function.

$$

$$

$$
f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}
$$

For the ReLU function, it can be simplified to:

$$
f'(x) = \begin{cases}
    1 & \text{if } x > 0 \\
    0 & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$
